# Sleek Koncepts

> Sleek Koncepts is a premier contemporary residential interior design and modular architecture studio based in Karimnagar, Telangana, India. Specializing in bespoke modular kitchens, luxury living rooms, serene master bedrooms, custom wardrobes, and turnkey full-home transformations.

## Core Brand Information
- **Brand Name**: Sleek Koncepts
- **Official Domain**: https://sleekkoncepts.com
- **Industry**: Interior Design, Modular Kitchens, Residential Architecture
- **Location**: 2-10-1651, Beside Shree Rama Sarees & Boutique, Chaitanyapuri, Karimnagar, Telangana 505001, India
- **Phone / WhatsApp**: +91 8143965633
- **Email**: kondapalkulasairam@gmail.com
- **Regions Served**: Karimnagar, Hyderabad, Warangal, Jagtial, Peddapalli, Sircilla, Ramagundam, and across Telangana, India
- **Operating Hours**: Monday to Saturday, 10:00 AM – 8:00 PM IST (Sunday Closed)

## Material Specifications & Quality Standards
- **Core Woodwork**: 100% Calibrated BWP (Boiling Water Proof) IS:710 Marine-Grade Plywood for all moisture-prone areas (kitchens, washroom vanities) with borer and termite resistance.
- **Hardware & Fittings**: Certified German soft-close hinges, heavy-duty tandem boxes, and lift-up systems from Blum, Hettich, and Hafele.
- **Surface Finishes**: High-gloss Anti-Scratch Acrylic, Ultra-Matte Polyurethane (PU) paint, Textured High-Pressure Laminates (HPL), Natural Wood Veneers.
- **Turnaround Timelines**: 25–30 days for modular kitchens or wardrobes; 45–60 working days for turnkey 2BHK/3BHK full home interiors.
- **Pricing Policy**: Transparent itemized Bill of Quantities (BOQ) with fixed square footage pricing and zero hidden fees.
